title:
A little leaf,
a lovely day

coverImage.alt: Orien and the orange cat discover a green leaf on a stone.

pages.title: A leaf on a stone
paragraphs: Orien found a green leaf resting on a sunny stone.
The orange cat came over. What could it become?

image.alt: Orien and the orange cat discover a green leaf on a stone.

pages.title: A little boat
paragraphs: The leaf slipped away into the little stream.
The cat reached out a paw, but it sailed on.

image.alt: The cat reaches toward a leaf floating in the stream as Orien watches.

pages.title: Across the bridge
paragraphs: Across the wooden bridge they hurried side by side.
Below them, their leaf boat bobbed along the stream.

image.alt: Orien and the cat cross a wooden bridge after the leaf.

pages.title: The leaf comes to rest
paragraphs: At last, the leaf boat came to rest on a stone.
The cat caught it with a paw. Orien leaned in to look.

image.alt: The cat touches the leaf on a stone while Orien watches.

pages.title: A little game
paragraphs: Beneath the big tree, the cat tapped the leaf.
Orien reached out a paw, and their little game began.

image.alt: Orien and the cat play with the leaf beside the big tree.

pages.title: Under the stars
paragraphs: When the stars came out, they curled up by the tree.
Their leaf lay close beside them, a little boat at rest.

image.alt: Orien and the cat rest beside the leaf beneath the tree at night.
